Download `FolderBridge.exe`, put it in a folder where it can stay and run it on both computers. On first start it offers a desktop shortcut and starting with Windows. The exe carries its own .NET runtime, so nothing else needs to be installed. When Windows Firewall asks, allow it on private networks.

Then click Pair a device on one computer, check that both show the same code, and add a folder. The README explains what happens to deleted and conflicting files.
